fact: The Maliweb review of the Transition's land reforms says a unique cadastral number (NINACAD) has been given to over 1.5 million parcels in Bamako's six communes, Kati cercle and several towns, and the digitised documents module MoDoNum was updated at the land conservatories of Bamako and Kati.

ORTM reports the Système d'informations foncières / Guichet unique du foncier (SIF/GUF) was presented to the Primature's steering committee on 18 March 2025, to be operational in the six communes of Bamako district, and to computerise land allocation and management procedures.

The permanent secretary of Mali's land reform said on 21 March 2024 that one million parcels had been digitised in the Bamako district, each with a unique cadastral national ID number (NINACAD), as part of the land reform.
